subject: general
question: In September 2021, Banwarilal Purohit was appointed as the governor of ________.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Banwarilal Purohit is the **Governor of Punjab.**
 
• He has been a **three-time Lok Sabha member from Nagpur.**
 
• He has also been the **Managing Editor of ‘The Hitavada**’, Central India’s oldest and largest circulated English daily for the last one hundred years. 
 
• He is an eminent educationist, a renowned social activist, an institution builder, and a nationalist thinker.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Bhagwant Mann is the Chief Minister of Punjab.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c68b652ae5f35cfdcae12bf462ac6c993c641f1d6e9dbfc9a8e96388c5f109c8.png]
